Strategy: Apply the gentle fifteen sweet band only when at least ten bins are open, keeping the mid penalty always on. This reserves steering for very crowded states where choices matter most, but the gate may rarely engage and the threshold is a guess.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if len(bins) >= 10 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
